title: Senior board game and safety programs in Peterborough - Monadnock Ledger-Transcript
text:
The Peterborough Senior Program has announced two upcoming programs for residents age 50 and over at the Peterborough Community Center.
“Let’s Play Board Games” will be held Mondays beginning March 2 from 1 to 3 p.m. in the Meeting Room. The cost is $3 for residents and $3.50 for nonresidents. Popcorn will be provided.
A free program on phone and computer safety will be offered Friday, March 6, from 9:30 to 10:30 a.m. in the Dining Room. The session will be led by Fash Farashahi and Tim Brezovec. Reservations are required by calling 603-784-5032.
